body.statement:
For a single binary treatment and a fixed multiplier \(\delta_0>0\), Kennedy's point-treatment incremental mean, after the notational substitutions \(\pi=e\) and \(\mu(\cdot,a)=\mu_a\), is
\[
E_P\!\left[
\frac{\delta_0e(X)\mu_1(X)+\{1-e(X)\}\mu_0(X)}
{\delta_0e(X)+1-e(X)}
\right].
\]

source.verbatim_statement: Corollary 1. When T = 1 the identifying expression for ψ(δ) simplifies to ψ(δ) = E[{δπ(X)μ(X,1)+{1−π(X)}μ(X,0)}/{δπ(X)+{1−π(X)}}], with μ(x,a)=E(Y | X=x,A=a).

attestation.note: Verified directly against the displayed Corollary 1 in arXiv:1704.00211v3, p. 6.
